category_edits.rationale: Apply the specified deterministic causal prefix-repeat feature with strength 0.1 across all four datasets. Preserve embeddings, Transformer, readout, loss and optimizer. The predictor imports the same SASRec class; synchronized metadata identifies the updated feature.

change_summary: Set prefix-repeat input scaling to 1 + 0.1 * min(log(1+c), 2), with matching training and predictor metadata. Retain one model per category and the 200-epoch cap.
